name: Nagira Kaho
source:
A girl in the same class as [url=https://vndb.org/c4700]Ryou[/url], she is the literary arts club president. She has a friendly personality, and she's very popular. She seems to be the quiet type, but when they were freshmen, she coerced Ryou into joining the club. She can be extremely forceful. She likes Ryou more than as just a friend, but she's going steady with [url=https://vndb.org/c10379]his best friend[/url].

[Edited from [url=https://www.jastusa.com/crescendo.html]JAST USA[/url]]
